newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers end steady, Med drops further.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers end steady, Med drops further.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices ended steady on Tuesday after wavering during the day, while Mediterranean prices dropped further, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST was quoted at $90/$91 fob towards the close. Prices initially rose, then fell before returning to levels similar to Monday's close as two players encouraged the market higher while one willed it down.

When prices dipped to around $89/$90, a number of shipowners proceeded with their enquiries. Larger amounts mostly went to majors who were able to offer at prices barely higher than barge market quotes.
Hamburg was forced down $2/$3 to redress the wide Rotterdam/Hamburg differential.
"It has been tricky giving quotes with Rotterdam in its current uncertain state," one supplier said.
Mediterranean prices all weakened. Fuel oil in southern France lost around $5 as Monday's rise proved unsustainable. Supply was also good and demand far from great.
Egyptian fuel oil bunkers were up around $2. Supplies in Port Said and Alexandria were very tight.
